recognize_zh: H&E 200x 見中大型淋巴細胞緊密成片，核圓至卵圓、染色質空泡狀、可見小核仁，偶見核分裂，右下緣有小淋巴球作對照，符合大B細胞淋巴瘤；是否為 IRF4 重組需靠 MUM1 與 FISH 確認。
features: Densely packed sheet of medium to large lymphoid cells with little intervening stroma
Round to oval, sometimes indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas
Scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies; rare histiocytes
Small mature lymphocytes at the periphery (lower right) for size comparison; thin fibrovascular septa
describe_en: Section at medium power shows sheets of monotonous medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies. Small mature lymphocytes are present at the periphery for comparison, and thin fibrovascular septa traverse the infiltrate. No starry-sky pattern or Reed-Sternberg-like cells are evident. Morphology is that of a large B-cell lymphoma; in conjunction with strong MUM1 expression and IRF4 rearrangement, findings are consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Pediatric-type FL has expansile follicles with blastoid centroblasts but is MUM1-negative/weak and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
Burkitt shows smaller monotonous cells with squared-off cytoplasm, a prominent starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
Morphologically similar; separation requires MUM1 immunostaining and IRF4 break-apart FISH.
Lymphoblasts have finer dusty chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and express TdT.
